title: outlinemode.test.ts: write the 4 it.todo renderer outline-mode tests
description: packages/core/src/engine/__tests__/outlinemode.test.ts has 4 it.todo cases (lines 75-89) documenting renderer outline-mode behavior. The implementation already exists in renderer.ts (renderLayer checks layer.outlineMode, calls renderShapeOutline / renderDisplayObjectOutline, uses layer.outlineColor). The tests just need to be written: (1) when outlineMode true, fill calls suppressed / only strokes emitted; (2) strokes use outlineColor not shape stroke color; (3) outlineMode false renders normally; (4) outlineColor is passed to canvas strokeStyle. Each test should construct a minimal SceneGraph with a SceneLayer carrying outlineMode/outlineColor, call CanvasRenderer, and inspect the canvas 2D mock context calls to verify fill vs stroke behavior.
